OpenDocument.core @opendocument/odr-core 7.7.0
License: MPL-2.0 (see odr-LICENSE)
Upstream source: https://github.com/opendocument-app/OpenDocument.core/tree/fae77ff7232cc79eecaebeb9e6839acf568d09c2
Modified source: the Flutter app bundle includes tools/odr/7.7.0.patch under the MPL-2.0.
Apply it to the revision above to obtain the corresponding source. It adds bounded workbook metadata and fixes ODS cell wrapping.
Third-party notices: odr-THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.zip.
Build script: https://github.com/Kobbokkom/kkomi/blob/d23c41e7a3dafd9dd8371d8355c02fd2ed42d408/tools/odr/build.sh
Run bash tools/odr/build.sh from that checkout with Conan 2, CMake, and Ninja (Emscripten 3.1.73 via upstream profile).
For a host compiler newer than Conan recognizes, set ODR_BUILD_PROFILE to an absolute compatible Conan profile.
The built index.js is named odr-7.7.0.mjs here.
